package.name: imu_orientation_filter
package.description: Madgwick 6-DOF orientation filter for the OpenMower IMU. Subscribes to the raw accelerometer/gyroscope stream from the low-level IMU service, integrates the gyro and corrects pitch/roll with the accelerometer-derived gravity vector, and continuously corrects yaw drift using the RTK-GNSS heading published by xbot_positioning. Publishes a sensor_msgs/Imu message with a fully populated orientation quaternion plus the original linear acceleration and angular velocity fields, after applying configurable mounting offsets and gyro bias obtained from the imu.calibrate_level RPC.
